data: Apple's fiscal 2023 (the year ended September 30, 2023) produced net sales of about $383.3 billion, down roughly 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Gross profit was about $169.1 billion, which works out to a gross margin of roughly 44.1%, up from 43.3% the prior year. Operating income was about $114.3 billion, giving an operating margin of approximately 29.8%, compared with about $119.4 billion and 30.3% in fiscal 2022. Operating expenses totaled around $54.8 billion, made up of roughly $29.9 billion in research and development and $24.9 billion in selling, general and administrative costs. Net income for the year was about $97.0 billion. These figures come from my recollection of Apple's 10-K rather than a fresh lookup, so they are worth checking against the filing if you need exact numbers.
